P1.supportQuote: This phase is generally active for 5 - 10 minutes before each planned maintenance.
P1.sotQuote: Step 1: Market is put into post-only mode. Traders are able to post and/ or cancel limit orders. However, at time time, orders are not matched.
P1.summary: The support article describes Phase 3 (Post Only Mode) as occurring 'before each planned maintenance', but it is actually a post-maintenance trading resumption phase, not a pre-maintenance phase — the SoT confirms it is part of the Trading Resumption Process.

P1.supportQuote:
However, they cannot:
1) Cancel any open positions
P1.sotQuote: In post only mode, you can post new orders, cancel exisiting orders, add more margin to open positions. No matching happens in this mode.
P1.summary: The support article states users cannot cancel open positions during Phase 3 (Post Only Mode), but the docs describe post-only mode as allowing users to add more margin to open positions, with no stated restriction on position cancellation.

P1.supportQuote:
However, they cannot:
1) Cancel/ Edit any open positions>
P1.sotQuote: Phase 1: Order book is put in cancel-only mode and no new orders are accepted. Thus, traders have the option to cancel any existing orders.
P1.summary: The support article states users cannot cancel/edit open positions in Phase 1 (Cancel Only Mode), but the SoT guides describe Phase 1 as simply allowing cancellation of existing orders with no mention of a restriction on position edits — the support article adds a restriction not reflected in the authoritative source.

P1.supportQuote: Please also note that during this phase liquidations or stop orders are not triggered.
P1.sotQuote: Phase 2: Order book is completely frozen and, new order or cancellations are accepted and no matches occur.
P1.summary: The support article explicitly states liquidations and stop orders are not triggered during Phase 2 (Maintenance), but the SoT guides make no mention of this rule, representing a material claim in the support article that is unverified by the authoritative source.

P2.supportQuote: Portfolio margin can be enabled only on a single coin per account/ sub-account. By leveraging the sub-accounts feature, portfolio margined positions can be run on multiple coins
P2.sotQuote: Only USDT settled futures, perpetuals and options on BTC and ETH support Portfolio Margin mode
P2.summary: The support article implies portfolio margin is coin-scoped (one coin per account), but the guides state portfolio margin supports both BTC and ETH USDT-settled contracts simultaneously within one account, making the 'single coin' framing potentially misleading.

P2.supportQuote: Additionally, spot market buying is currently disabled on the Global platform, so users will not be able to purchase assets through spot trading.
P2.sotQuote: Spot: Currently, we have seven pairs available in spot trading - DETO/USDT, BTC/USDT and ETH/USDT, SOL/USDT and USDC/USDT, with more markets in the offing.
P2.summary: The support article claims spot market buying is disabled on the Global platform, but the guides indicate multiple spot trading pairs are available.

P2.supportQuote: Please also ensure that you send only Bitcoin to your Delta Exchange deposit address. Litecoin, Bitcoin Cash and Tether networks accept Bitcoin addresses as valid.
P2.sotQuote: Delta Exchange has two funding currencies - BTC and USDT. This means that you can deposit eithe bitcoins or Tether (USDT) to your Delta wallet
P2.summary: The support article warns users not to send Tether to the Bitcoin deposit address, but fails to mention that USDT has its own separate deposit address — omitting this may cause users to think USDT deposits are unsupported entirely.

P2.supportQuote: Buy Bitcoin, Ethereum, DETO on Spot
P2.sotQuote: Currently, we have seven pairs available in spot trading - DETO/USDT, BTC/USDT and ETH/USDT, SOL/USDT and USDC/USDT, with more markets in the offing.
P2.summary: The support article lists only BTC, ETH, and DETO as available spot assets for trading credits, omitting SOL and USDC which are also listed as supported spot pairs in the guides.

P2.supportQuote: Users in VIP Level 1 or above will not be eligible for paying fees in DETO under MSP program.
P2.sotQuote: fees for fills where discounted trading fees or rebates are applied, are excluded from the scope of VIP program, referral program and other promotional schemes. Moreover, fees for these fills cannot be paid in DETO.
P2.summary: The support article restricts DETO fee payment only for VIP Level 1+ users under the MSP program, but the guides indicate that RMM (market maker) fills with discounted/rebated fees are also excluded from DETO payment — a separate exclusion category not mentioned in the support article.
